programmes.d: Athletes are meeting in Tiberias, Israel, for the PWA World Cup. This first leg of this year's competition will be filled with action after 18 months of inactivity.

In this episode, we are in the TwinTip open Worlds in Hangloose beach, Italy where Florian Gruber has defended his title for the 3rd time! Then, we are set to join the Kite World Series in China’s Weifang and Pingtan where the fastest foilers are ready to set new records in kite foiling.
In this episode we will focus on the action around the 2019 Kite Foil World Series, which is composed by four non-discard events. This means that all the event scores will be counted.

Up to 200 surfers from 40 nations will battle for a medal in the ISA World Surfing Games 2017. Biarritz La Grande Plage will host the event, thus celebrating the 60th anniversary of surfing’s arrival in France.

Ride to the roots is a simple format documentary series that focuses on athletes and artists. We will, almost literally, ride to the roots of these peculiar characters that have a unique upbringing, personal background, origin or past.
After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing.

In this new episode of Sail-Ho Croatia, we explore the Markaska Riviera. This area is best known for its beautiful natural beaches and amazing gastronomic delights. Makarska is the center of the Markaska riviera, and it is a hub of culture, education and tourism. Let's discover it.

Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! The city of Split was formed around the Roman Emperor Diocletian's Palace, and this was built as his retirement residence. However, we have certainly found it as one of the most exciting, fun and action-packed places in the Adriatic. Let's catch up on Split's action.

Join host Andi van Zyl in South Africa for one of the toughest canoe races in the world! The Dusi Canoe Marathon famously pits competitors against powerful rapids and unpredictable wildlife, and the 2014 edition will feature SUP riders for the first time in the event’s history.

From big and energetic cities to beautiful small villages, Quebec has it all. A stunning coastline and amazing food, but more than anything else, pristine wilderness. The Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean region boasts three national parks and a dramatic Saguenay Fjord.

Montreal is a historic and multicultural place that pulses with energy. What makes it particularly amazing is that it also provides easy access to outdoor activities and world-class paddling opportunities, both inside and outside city limits.

Welcome to the Lee Valley White Water Centre just outside London for the World Cup 1 of the ICF Canoe Slalom. We will be talking you through the action of this competition: it is going to be canoe single men followed by the kayak single women. Follow us for slalom competition at its highest level.
Welcome to Bratislava, in Slovakia, for round two of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup.
